label: Challenges
description: One-time challenges a policy opens when its outcome says `challenge`. The guard opens one and tells the caller its id and how to obtain a code; a trigger of the tree issues the code through `issue` -- printed by the example, delivered by mail or SMS in a real tree, which is the binding's business -- and the guard verifies the code the caller presents next time, hashed, within its attempts and its time.

issue.description: Give an open challenge its code. `issued` is false for a challenge that is unknown, expired or spent; otherwise its id, the code and when it expires.

id.description: the challenge id the caller was told
